title: Cohomology of a module sheaf agrees with that of its underlying abelian sheaf
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme with its small Zariski site [def-sc-zariski-site], and let $\mathcal F$ be any sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules. Write $\mathcal F_{\mathrm{ab}}$ for the same sheaf after forgetting the module structure. For every $q\geq0$, the $q$-th right-derived global sections of $\mathcal F$ computed in sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-cohomology] and those of $\mathcal F_{\mathrm{ab}}$ computed in abelian sheaves [def-sc-zariski-cohomology] are canonically isomorphic as abelian groups, naturally in $\mathcal F$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03FD (lemma-cohomology-modules-abelian-agree), first assertion, specialized to the small Zariski site of a scheme

proof.text: Set T = SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace), Gamma = abelian evaluation at the top open, G = module global sections and V = module-to-abelian-group forgetful. T preserves finite limits by Mathlib and finite colimits by the proved source instance SheafOfModules.preservesFiniteColimits_toSheaf. Thus T preserves homology and quasi-isomorphisms. This realizes the exactness assertion of lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-colimits-forgetful without importing its larger packaging theorem.

Prove the private topCohomologyEquiv: the representable presheaf of the top open has a unique element in every degree. FreeAbelianGroup.uniqueEquiv followed by the inverse lift equivalence identifies its free abelian presheaf with constant lifted integers. FreeAbelianGroup.lift_ext proves naturality on generators. Apply presheafToSheaf.mapIso and Ext.precompAddEquiv to identify Sheaf.H' F q top with Sheaf.H F q. Prove topCohomologyIsoDerived by composing this with H.equiv₀ and rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf in degree zero, and cohomology_nonempty_addEquiv_rightDerived_evaluation_succ in positive degrees. These are fully proved private glue declarations, not new unresolved statements.

Install enough injectives for module sheaves from the proved moduleSheaves_abelian_enoughInjectives theorem for X.toRingedSpace; abelian-sheaf enough injectives is the unchanged explicit assumption hE. For every injective module I and n : Nat, injective_module_abelian_acyclic at the top open gives Subsingleton (Sheaf.H' (T.obj I) (n+1) top). The preceding Ext/derived-evaluation isomorphism and AddCommGrpCat.isZero_of_subsingleton give Gamma.rightAcyclic (T.obj I).

Choose I = injectiveResolution F. Compose the inverse component of HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex T with T.mapHomologicalComplex.map I.iota to obtain a resolution iota of T.obj F by T(I). Exactness from step 1 makes the mapped augmentation a quasi-isomorphism; composing with the single-complex isomorphism preserves this. Its terms are Gamma-acyclic by step 3. The proved source Gamma.rightDerivedObjIsoOfResolution iota gives R^q Gamma(TF) isomorphic to the homology of Gamma(T(I)).

I.isoRightDerivedObj G q computes moduleCohomology as the homology of G(I). The exact functor V commutes with this homology by ShortComplex.mapHomologyIso. The section functors G composed with V and T composed with Gamma are definitionally equal; mapHomologicalComplexCompIso packages their identical section complexes and the association with Gamma(T(I)). Compose these complex homology isomorphisms with the inverse acyclic-resolution isomorphism from step 4 and the inverse Ext/derived-evaluation isomorphism of step 2. This is the unchanged Nonempty isomorphism in every natural degree q.
